40/S0.subgoal: Explain the goal of navigation and identify the four broad types of locomotion techniques.

40/S1.subgoal: Describe the various categories of walking-based locomotion techniques.

40/S2.subgoal: Describe steering-based locomotion techniques, including spatial and physical types.

40/S3.subgoal: Explain selection-based and manipulation-based locomotion techniques.

40/S4.subgoal: Explain the concept of wayfinding and how to provide support for it in a virtual environment.

40/S5.subgoal: Describe interaction techniques for system control.

40/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
